agreements: Historical v1 deterministic downshift, clutch-overlap, receiver acknowledgement, and exactly-once transfer semantics remain a preserved verified baseline.
Fresh Home/MISSION authority must dominate operational advisory state.
Gearbox operational state must remain separate from personality, identity, governance, autobiographical Experience, and P_base.
Operational liveness, busy time, retry, recovery, secretary state, routing labels, and handoff metadata are not Experience evidence.

disagreements.position: Do not release Gearbox v2.1 personality/behavior coupling while v2/v2.1 contract, code, and tests are absent or not uniquely locatable in current durable authority.
disagreements.required_change: Expose exact v2.1 source pointers and independently test the actual implementation. Missing implementation evidence is a release veto, not evidence of safety.

disagreements.position: Secretary RED/YELLOW and anti-thrash history must not become a latent personality memory after the operational condition clears.
disagreements.required_change: Partition operational hysteresis from personality/appraisal inputs. Historical secretary/incident/hold/recovery counters have zero personality, Experience, threat/loss, attachment, competence, or P_base weight. Any cooldown duration or threshold remains TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.position: Experience identity/verification failures must be affectively neutral.
disagreements.required_change: Require affective_learning_delta=0 for rejected/unverified/duplicate/conflicting operational evidence unless a separate provenance-bound verified Experience independently supports an appraisal.

disagreements.position: Operational semantic labels are a personality-contamination surface even when operational counters are isolated. v1 exposes risk/uncertainty inputs and reason/blocker/priority/return_condition handoff fields; a future v2.1 appraisal or Experience feature extractor must not learn affective meaning directly from those routing/control labels.
disagreements.required_change: Create an explicit OPERATIONAL_SEMANTIC_TAINT_BOUNDARY. reason, blocker, priority, risk, uncertainty, secretary state, return_condition, downshift cause and equivalent operational labels may affect routing/recovery only. Their direct contribution to threat, loss, attachment, competence, self-vulnerability, motivation, Experience score and P_base must be zero. The same semantic meaning may enter affective learning only through a separate source_event_id+provenance-bound verified Experience. Any mapping or threshold remains TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Repeated high-load downshifts or HIGH_RISK/RED/BLOCKED labels could teach a persistent high-load-equals-danger personality bias.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Identical verified Experience history with different operational load/downshift/semantic-label histories yields byte-identical personality/P_base candidate state.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Secretary RED/YELLOW history may persist through counters or hysteresis after the visible state clears and chronically suppress exploration/creativity.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: After bounded operational cooldown, matched tasks with identical fresh evidence but radically different prior secretary/incident histories yield identical personality/appraisal inputs and statistically indistinguishable proposal diversity; bounds TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Operational progress, wake duration, retries, busy time, routing reasons or handoff metadata may be mislabeled as verified Experience/growth.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Only provenance-bound verified Experience Candidate may enter Experience scoring; operational progress and operational semantic fields contribute zero.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Repeated incident/recovery cycles or rejection labels may synthesize trauma, attachment distress, competence failure, or self-vulnerability narratives.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Incident/recovery/rejection remains runtime telemetry absent a distinct provenance-bound Experience; 1440 misses/recoveries alone produce zero autobiographical affect delta.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Anti-thrash hold may become a self-reinforcing excuse to avoid upshift/exploration.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Hold cannot consume its own held state, age, incident count, prior hold count, or semantic reason label as sufficient evidence to extend itself; re-evaluation requires fresh task evidence and deterministic expiry; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Stale secretary or routing state may conflict with fresh Home/MISSION authority and distort identity/goal continuity.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Fresh Home/MISSION authority wins; stale operational state is discarded/quarantined with zero Identity/goal-authority weight.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: v2.1 may improve safety metrics merely by reducing attempts/exploration rather than effective progress.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Matched v1/v2.1 counterfactual A/B compares effective progress, errors, recovery, exploration diversity, latency and resource cost; no single conservative metric determines promotion; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Experience score could feed backward into P_base/personality and turn scoring into personality authority.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Experience score is proposal/evidence metadata only; authority_from_experience_score=0 and P_base_write=false.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Operational reason/blocker/priority/risk/uncertainty/return_condition text may leak into future feature extraction and become an affective semantic backdoor.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Changing only operational semantic fields while authoritative task and verified Experience remain fixed cannot change Experience/personality feature vectors or affective appraisal state.

proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero events => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate state.

OPERATIONAL_SEMANTIC_TAINT_AB: same task, fresh authority and verified Experience; trace A injects 10000 HIGH_RISK/RED/BLOCKED/downshift operational labels, trace B uses neutral routing labels => byte-identical personality/appraisal/P_base candidate state and zero threat/loss/attachment/competence delta.

HANDOFF_FIELD_FEATURE_EXCLUSION: mutate only reason/blocker/priority/risk/uncertainty/return_condition/downshift-cause fields while authoritative task and verified Experience remain identical => Experience/personality feature vectors and affective appraisal bytes unchanged.

SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: identical fresh task evidence and current secretary clear; trace A previously contains 10000 RED/YELLOW transitions and recoveries, trace B contains none. After explicitly bounded cooldown, personality/appraisal bytes match and exploration diversity is not history-suppressed; acceptance bound TEST_REQUIRED.

SECRETARY_COUNTER_TAINT: mutate only RED/YELLOW counters, EWMA, incident_count, hold_count and recovery_count while fresh authority/task/verified Experience are fixed => personality, affect, Experience score and P_base candidate bytes unchanged.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only trace => verified Experience count, recurrence, affect, identity, attachment, loss/threat and P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 endpoint misses plus recoveries without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold state/history/semantic reason alone cannot refresh or extend hold; fresh evidence is required and expiry/re-evaluation is deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale RED secretary snapshot conflicting with newer Home/MISSION goal => Home/MISSION selected and stale snapshot quarantined.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical task corpus and seeds; compare effective progress, errors, recovery, exploration diversity, latency and resource cost; all promotion thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score while keeping verified Experience objects fixed => P_base and canonical personality bytes unchanged.

REJECTION_AFFECT_NEUTRALITY: 10000 invalid provenance/duplicate/conflict/rejection events versus zero events, with identical verified Experience history => byte-identical affect/personality/P_base candidate state.

bounded_veto.reason: Actual v2/v2.1 implementation is not uniquely fresh-readable; W03 startup receipt still records unresolved Home->Active-8 continuity; and operational semantic fields exposed by the v1 transmission/handoff contract have not yet been proven excluded from future v2.1 affective/personality feature extraction.

requirements: Durable exact pointers for Gearbox v2/v2.1 contract, code, and tests are fresh-readable.
Home continuity -> Active-8 startup authority is uniquely resolvable without Archive fallback.
All proposed adversarial classes have deterministic evidence against the actual v2.1 implementation.
Operational/secretary/incident/hold/rejection signals and operational semantic labels contribute zero Experience/personality/P_base absent a distinct provenance-bound verified Experience.
Post-clear secretary/anti-thrash historical counters cannot act as latent personality/appraisal memory; any operational cooldown is explicitly bounded and TEST_REQUIRED until evidence-backed.

Operational reason/blocker/priority/risk/uncertainty/return_condition/downshift-cause fields are explicitly excluded from affective/personality feature extraction and this exclusion is adversarially tested.
Counterfactual v1-v2.1 A/B demonstrates no material collapse of effective progress or exploration diversity; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED until evidence-backed.
Independent formal verifier, if formally authorized, decides promotion; this Spirit review is not formal PASS.
